title: Wire Gut-Check
one_liner: Paste a payment request and get a red-flag score plus a callback script to verify it.
headline: Paste a suspicious payment email and get highlighted red flags, a risk score, and a word-for-word callback script that always points to a number already on file.

episode.title: Making Sense of This Week’s AI Market Crashes | #x307

history.summary: This is a genuinely working, honest rules-based scanner: it analyzes the clerk's own pasted text client-side, highlights real matched phrases per category, computes a transparent weighted score, and always returns a callback script that never uses a number from the message. All four acceptance criteria check out against the code and the smoke-test screenshots, the three bundled examples are well-crafted to trigger every rule category, and the optional BYOK AI add-on is clearly labeled and never persisted. Polish gaps are minor: no feedback on an empty-text submit, and the matched-list shows every raw phrase hit (not deduped) which could read as inconsistent with the deduped score.
